work.abstract_text: Applying and extending halasz_resonator's inverse calculation (2026, Theorem 4(1)), we prove Sequence Machine's conjecture A322026(n)=A323884(25n), recorded by Antti Karttunen in the final Formula of OEIS A322026, revision 41, 8 September 2024. The rank function a=A322026 is unchanged on multiplying its argument by a prime greater than 3. We show that this invariance forces its Dirichlet inverse b=A323883 to vanish at every multiple of the square of such a prime. We classify all positive multipliers: A323884(Mn)=a(n) for every positive n exactly when gcd(M,6)=1 and M is not squarefree. The same argument proves and extends Karttunen's recorded 2022 identity A126760(n)=A323882(4n). We prove the neighboring rank and ordinal-transform identities and distinguish the smooth-number rank array from the rational rank array in a cross-referenced entry.

work.title: Multiplier classifications resolving Sequence Machine's conjecture in OEIS A322026, revision 41, final Formula (8 September 2024): extensions of halasz_resonator's inverse calculation (2026)
